text_block_list.text:
Hey, Groove. I was going through some
clothes
that my parents sent me, and I
think some of
them would look perfect
on you.
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Um, I really don't think that would suit
me very
well...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, it can't hurt to give it a try! Just
this once!
You'll do it for me, right?
Great!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: H-hold on, I never said I would! Ugh, fine. Have it your way.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I can't... fit inside? Impossible... Have I
put on
weight?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's true that I've been too lax
with my
training recently...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I need to talk with my trainer and
request a more
strenuous regimen.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Groove! Come back! I just

noticed—these are from when I was a
little girl!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
She didn't hear me... Oh well, I'll tell her
when she
comes back!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Although it may have begun as a

misunderstanding, Эйр Грув's new
regimen
nonetheless has the desired
effect.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
